reason: I already have my stuff that I reorder when it runs out, and I'm not looking to add or swap anything. The lab report is a nice touch, but a named lab doesn't give me a reason to leave what I already use.
objection: Made in China, and I have no history with this brand. A report on a page is only as good as the lab behind it, and I can't check that from my phone in bed.
would_change_my_mind: A gym buddy or a creator I already follow actually using it for a few weeks and showing the lab report, plus a cheap single box under $15 to try without dropping my current routine.
